_comment: Three wrong senses of one word each, all shipped. 'Mint' was read as the herb: 薄荷碼 is 'peppermint code' and 薄荷糖 is mint candy, so Connection Points offered 'self-approve mint-candy access'. 'Token' was read as a coin: 代幣 is an arcade or crypto token, so the page announced 'Arcade-Token Elevation'. Worst is chrome.hsm.tabSlotsTokens -- 老虎機 is a casino slot machine, so the PKCS#11 hardware-security-module tab was labelled 'Slot Machines and Coins'. And cancelCredential lost its verb entirely: 祖岡日期 is German Zugang sounded out plus Daten misread as Datum, so a Cancel button was labelled 'Zugang Date'. Two further wrong senses ride along: the OT Credentials and OT Rotation page titles said 證書, which is a certificate or diploma rather than a stored account secret, and the HSM Advanced tab said 先進的, the adjective for technologically cutting-edge, where a tab label needs the ordinal sense. One 'token' here is deliberately not 令牌: chrome.training.packsUnresolved counts unfilled template placeholders, not security tokens -- the German pivot rendered it Platzhalter and this pack's own packsNoTokens says 填入標記, so the counter follows that rather than the security term. Fixes otherwise use this pack's own established wording -- 鑄造 for mint (already in 鑄造提升權限代碼), 令牌 for security token (81-use majority), 插槽 for slot (already in 插槽號), 認證資料 for credentials (already in sectionLanding.group.credentials), 進階 for Advanced (already in liveSession.advanced). AGENT DRAFTS -- native review still required.
